title: 印度尼西亚中华道教协会贺信
title_en: Indonesian Chinese Taoist Association Congratulatory Letter
body: 印度尼西亚中华道教协会致函祝贺，表达对国际道教合作的支持与期许。
body_en: The Indonesian Chinese Taoist Association sent congratulations, expressing support and expectations for international Taoist cooperation.
